source.source_locator: 危険物の規制に関する政令 第25条第4号

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 第四類危険物は炎・火花・高温体との接近又は過熱を避け、みだりに蒸気を発生させない。
evidence.tested_misconception: 第四類は液体なので火花や蒸気発生への配慮は不要である。
evidence.reasoning_path: Class 4 -> identify ignition/vapor hazards -> avoid heat/sparks and unnecessary vapor generation

collision.note: B3 Tier A; Class-4-specific common rule.

independent_review.rationale: Class-4-specific flame/spark/high-temperature/vapor rule is directly relevant to Otsu4.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 22 accepted candidates test concrete storage and handling duties, quantitative boundaries, Class-4-specific controls, or explicit sale/record obligations without material collision with the 29 canonical Otsu4 questions. C016 and C017 are too abstract to add sufficient practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
